::: {#exr-poisson-mean-and-variance}
#### Mean and variance

Write down the population mean and variance of a single observation
from the model, as functions of the parameters.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-poisson-mean-and-variance}

- Population mean: $\E{X} = \rate$.
- Population variance: $\Var{X} = \rate$.

The sample mean and variance in @tbl-dobson-cyclones-sumstat
are of similar size, as the model implies.
:::
